value.rationale: A natural pair of record processes defined on a permutation and its inverse has an exact diagonal cross-covariance matrix at all finite sizes, even though their entire vectors depend on the same permutation. The unique exceptional alignment mechanism explains the cross-index localization. The theorem yields the full weighted cross-covariance bilinear form and exact aggregate decorrelation scale; neither is a routine relabeling of the classical one-direction independent record indicators.
